title: A guard refuses `| tail` on `merge --lane-lint` or `verdict`, which hides the result
why: Twice on Nov 7 a `| tail` on `merge --lane-lint` or `verdict` hid the result (lane fix-check-after-notes-commit, 16:22 CST). verdict-pipe in PR #1515 covers verdict only.
note: Same guard home as step bg-tail-loses-verdict, which may take it. Also the coordinator's brief-template step: run the lane lint before each fix check. Done check: the piped lane-lint form is red on main, then refused. Folded into lane bg-tail-loses-verdict (coordinator, 16:22 CST). Incident 3, Nov 7 23:40 CST (lane notes-fix-page, proposed step pipe-masks-verdict): `python3 ~/.claude/lint/ste_lint.py <file> | tail -1 && git commit ... && git push` took tail's exit code, so b613b336c on #1754 was pushed with an STE error. The lane's guard: refuse any lint or test command piped into head or tail and then chained to `&& git commit` or `&& git push`, and point at `verdict <cmd>` (rule tokens-run-through-verdict). Not yet known whether the check-tail gate reads ste_lint.py; if not, this lane or check-tail-wrapper-forms takes the form. Sightings (lane draft-pr-guard-text-false-alarm (session_013NEJL232Ko7dmr4v3fmrvF), 08:44 CST Nov 8): at 08:23 CST `merge --lane-lint HEAD | tail -1 && git push` hid a lint FAIL, and a failing head reached the PR branch; at 08:42 the same with `| tail -3; echo rc=$?`. Its proposed step gate-pipe-hides-exit is this step's guard. The second form, `; echo rc=$?` after the pipe, reads tail's code, so the remedy names pipefail or a log file.
